authStory.title: What you do every day transforms you.
authStory.intro: Build habits that feel good. One day at a time, at your own pace.
authStory.footer: Grow a life that feels like you.

desktopSetup.title: Connect to your HabitMaker server
desktopSetup.intro: Enter the address of the server where your habits live. You can change it later from Settings.
desktopSetup.apiUrlHint: For example, http://localhost:8080/api or https://habits.example.com. If you only enter the server address, /api is added automatically.
desktopSetup.invalidUrl: Enter a valid http or https URL.
desktopSetup.unreachable: Couldn't reach the HabitMaker API at that address. Check the URL and that the server is running.
desktopSetup.footer: Your data stays on your own server.

login.title: Log in
login.intro: Pick up your habits right where you left off.
login.passwordInvalid: Password must be at least 8 characters long.
login.error: Couldn't log in. Check your credentials and try again.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.intro: Just a few details to start building new habits.
signup.name: Name
signup.emailHelp: We'll use your email to access your account.
signup.passwordInvalid: Password must be at least 8 characters long.
signup.terms: I agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
signup.termsRequired: You must accept the terms to create an account.
signup.error: Couldn't create your account. Check your details and try again.

recover.sentMessage: If an account exists for {{email}}, you'll receive a link to reset your password.
recover.title: Reset your password
recover.intro: Enter your account email and we'll send you instructions to create a new password.
recover.error: Couldn't process your request. Please try again.

resetPassword.title: Create a new password
resetPassword.intro: Choose a secure password with at least 8 characters.
resetPassword.passwordInvalid: Password must be at least 8 characters long.
resetPassword.invalidLink: This password reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one to continue.
resetPassword.error: Couldn't change your password. Please try again.
resetPassword.successMessage: Your new password has been saved successfully.

home.title: Your habits
home.activityError: Couldn't update your activity. Please try again.
home.intro: Your space to build habits that are good for you starts here.
home.newHabitModal: What habit would you like to create?

today.title: Today {{date}}
today.allDoneMessage: Congratulations! You completed all your habits today.

newHabit.title: What habit would you like to create?
newHabit.intro: Start with something simple you'd like to do more often.
newHabit.label: Your habit
newHabit.hint: The more specific it is, the easier it is to get started.
newHabit.nameRequired: Enter a name for the habit.
newHabit.nameTooLong: The habit name must be 100 characters or fewer.
newHabit.error: Couldn't save your habit. Please try again.

habitDetail.title: Habit details
habitDetail.activityError: Couldn't update your activity. Please try again.
habitDetail.editInvalidName: The habit name can't be empty.
habitDetail.editNameTooLong: The habit name must be 100 characters or fewer.
habitDetail.editError: Couldn't update this habit. Please try again.
habitDetail.deleteSectionDescription: This will permanently delete the habit and all of its activity history.

habitDetail.congratulations: Congratulations, you've completed your habit today!
habitDetail.encouragement: Consistency is built one small step at a time. Keep it up!
habitDetail.question: Have you completed your habit today?
habitDetail.instructions: Tap today on the habit card to mark it as complete.
habitDetail.reminderDescription: Choose a time for a push notification. It follows your device's local time, including daylight saving changes. Reminders are skipped after you complete this habit for the day.
habitDetail.reminderTimePending: Save the change to apply the new time.
habitDetail.reminderBlocked: Notifications are blocked. Allow them in your browser or device settings to enable reminders.
habitDetail.reminderUnsupported: Push notifications are unavailable in this browser or have not been configured for this app.

habitDetail.unarchiveSectionDescription: This habit is currently archived and hidden from your home screen. Archived habits are read-only: no activity can be logged until you unarchive it.
